name: com.mayhemengine.debugger
description: Decision-chain debugger for Unity: records the chain of checks that produced a gameplay/AI decision and shows exactly which one failed, instead of just the current state. Includes break-on-fail (auto-pause Play Mode on a specific failing step). Native C++ core (MayhemEngine/MayhemDebugger) behind a P/Invoke bridge.

samples.description: Enemy-attack decision chain (target acquired / in range / line of sight / cooldown) -- the same scenario as the C++ console and ImGui demos, ported to a MonoBehaviour.
